mapper.insert: INSERT INTO POLICY_APP_HISTORY (POLICY_APP_ID, GOV_PROJECT_CODE, MEMBER_ID, APP_DATE, APP_STATUS) VALUES (#{policyAppId}, #{govProjectCode}, #{memberId}, NOW(), 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT h.POLICY_APP_ID, h.APP_DATE, h.APP_STATUS, p.GOV_PROJECT_NAME, p.GOV_PROJECT_DATE FROM POLICY_APP_HISTORY h JOIN GOV_SUPPORT_POLICY p ON h.GOV_PROJECT_CODE = p.GOV_PROJECT_CODE WHERE h.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.APP_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO JOB_APP_HISTORY (JOB_APP_ID, JOB_POSTING_CODE, MEMBER_ID, APP_DATE, APP_STATUS) VALUES (#{jobAppId}, #{jobPostingCode}, #{memberId}, NOW(), 'Y')
mapper.select: SELECT h.JOB_APP_ID, h.JOB_POSTING_CODE, h.MEMBER_ID, h.APP_DATE, h.APP_STATUS, r.JOB_POSTING_NAME, r.JOB_POSTING_DATE FROM JOB_APP_HISTORY h JOIN RECRUITMENT r ON h.JOB_POSTING_CODE = r.JOB_POSTING_CODE WHERE h.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY h.APP_DATE DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO CERT_EXAM_APP_HISTORY (CERT_EXAM_APP_ID, MEMBER_ID, CERT_CODE, EXAM_SESSION) VALUES (#{certExamAppId}, #{memberId}, #{certCode}, #{examSession})
mapper.select: SELECT h.CERT_EXAM_APP_ID, h.MEMBER_ID, h.CERT_CODE, h.EXAM_SESSION, c.CERT_NAME, e.EXAM_DATE FROM CERT_EXAM_APP_HISTORY h JOIN CERT_EXAM e ON h.CERT_CODE = e.CERT_CODE AND h.EXAM_SESSION = e.EXAM_SESSION JOIN CERT c ON h.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE WHERE h.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} ORDER BY e.EXAM_DATE DESC

SELECT 'JOB' AS allpcj, r.JOB_POSTING_CODE AS code, r.JOB_POSTING_NAME AS title, r.JOB_REGI_LASTDAY AS startDate, r.RECRUITMENT_INFO AS info FROM JOB_APP_HISTORY j JOIN RECRUITMENT r ON j.JOB_POSTING_CODE = r.JOB_POSTING_CODE WHERE j.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}

SELECT c.CERT_NAME AS certName, ce.EXAM_REGI_FIRSTDAY AS examStart, ce.EXAM_REGI_LASTDAY AS examEnd FROM CERT_EXAM_APP_HISTORY h JOIN CERT_EXAM ce ON h.CERT_CODE = ce.CERT_CODE AND h.EXAM_SESSION = ce.EXAM_SESSION JOIN CERT c ON h.CERT_CODE = c.CERT_CODE WHERE h.MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
